description: Agent preflight round 2: a short brief of an operator’s succession arrangements. Input text, fields (successor, trigger, key_transfer, account_transfer, timeline, receives) or both. The signed brief restates the arrangement in order: who takes over, what sets it off, how the keys and the accounts pass, on what timeline and what the successor receives, in the arrangement’s own words, and names each gap plainly: no successor named, no trigger defined, no transfer path for keys or accounts, no timeline, or nothing said about what the successor receives. POST /api/succession-brief. Reads only the material in the call: no page fetch, no registry or chain lookup, no counterparty contact, and no payment signed, submitted or moved. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-preflight-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/preflight/.

inputSchema.description: Send the text, the fields or both.

fields.description: The arrangements as fields. A field given here takes precedence over the text for that element.

account_transfer.description: How the accounts and logins reach the successor.

key_transfer.description: How the signing keys and wallet keys reach the successor.

receives.description: What the successor receives: accounts, funds, catalogs, contracts or the business.

successor.description: Who takes over: a named person, role or contact.

timeline.description: When each step happens: a waiting period, deadlines or dates.

trigger.description: The event or condition that starts the succession, for example no check-in for 30 days.

format.description: html reduces the markup to readable text first. Defaults to html when the text starts with a tag, otherwise text.

label.description: Optional name for the material, recorded in the report.

text.description: The succession arrangements as written, up to 64 KB.

name: wever_succession-brief
title: Succession brief
